title: A change that can lock people or EasyRMM out, lose data, or cannot be undone from here
paragraphs: This change can cut access to the computer, lock accounts, lose data, or be impossible to undo remotely. It is made on one computer at a time.

Where the change could cut EasyRMM's own way in, the computer starts a timer before the change. If the agent has not reported back when the timer ends, the computer undoes the change by itself, and the item is marked as failed.
Read the preconditions below. You must type the computer's name to show that you mean this computer, and confirm it is you with your second factor.
undoNote: Undo puts back the value the computer had before, if the record of the change is still on the computer.
